sub.en: The 7 representative final sounds, liaison rule (연음) and pronunciation guide
sub.ko: 받침 7개 대표음, 연음 법칙, 소리 나는 대로 읽기

desc.en: Free printable Korean worksheet on 받침 (batchim / final consonants): the 7 representative sounds ([ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ]), the liaison rule (연음), pronunciation practice and an answer key.

rows: ㄷ, ㅅ, ㅆ, ㅈ, ㅊ, ㅌ, ㅎ
sections.note: When spoken in isolation or before a consonant, all Korean final consonants simplify into one of these 7 representative sounds: [ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ].

rows: Batchim carries over to the next syllable
Batchim takes over the initial ㅇ slot
ㄱ / ㄷ / ㅂ changes to ㅇ / ㄴ / ㅁ before ㄴ / ㅁ
Plain consonant becomes tense (ㄲ/ㄸ/ㅃ/ㅆ/ㅉ) after ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ
sections.note: Liaison is the most frequent rule in everyday Korean: usually carry the final consonant sound over into the following vowel (exceptions: final ㅇ stays as 'ng', and final ㅎ is usually silent, as in 좋아 [조아]).

title.en: Liaison: How to Carry the Sound Over
title.ko: 소리 나는 대로 읽는 연음 법칙

sections.text: When a syllable ending with a batchim is followed by a syllable starting with the silent vowel placeholder ㅇ, move the final consonant sound directly into that vowel: 물 + 이 → [무리], 밥 + 을 → [바블], 옷 + 이 → [오시]. If a consonant follows, pronounce the representative sound: 옷장 → [옫짱].

title.ko: 대표 받침 소리([ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ])를 써요

Practice D: Write the correct spoken sound

howto: Learn the 7 representative sounds: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ, ㅂ, ㅇ.
Practice carrying the final consonant into the next syllable when meeting a vowel (Liaison).
Complete Practice A to D and check your results with the answer key.
koSummary: 받침의 7개 대표음([ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ])과 가장 기초적인 연음 법칙, 비음화, 경음화를 한 장에 정리했습니다. 대표음 찾기와 소리 나는 대로 발음 쓰기 연습을 풀고 정답지로 확인하세요.
